item_name: Rothco Orange Mini Pick & Shovel with Cover
item_short_desc: Stay ready with Rothco’s Orange Mini Pick & Shovel with Cover, the perfect 2-in-1 tool for smaller digging tasks. Its dual-purpose shovel and pick head loosen soil, cut roots, and more. With a portable, folding design, the outdoor tool measures 17 inches open and 10 inches folded. The canvas cover protects the tool when not in use while the rubber handle ensures a firm grip, The Pick & Shovel tool is ideal for campers, hikers, survivalists, gardeners, and is great for bug out bags.
